description: Template for an air-gapped workstation bundle. Copy this file, fill in the real file names, versions and SHA-256 digests on the connected staging machine, then verify on the isolated machine with: python tools-o3d.py install verify --manifest <file> --base-dir <bundle>
notes: Every entry needs file, version, platform, sha256 and license before the bundle is released.
Digests must be produced on the staging machine, not typed by hand: python tools-o3d.py hash --file <each file>.
Never add a network install step to an air-gapped machine; stage silently-installable artifacts instead.

files.install: untar into the DCC asset library path recorded in project-config.json
